# Evaluation results (generated by scripts/evaluate.py)

Seeds per data point: 5 (test seeds 900000+). Values are mean ± standard deviation across seeds. Simulated time unit: 1 ms.
DQN model: checkpoint from training episode 60 (selected by best validation score 7.892).

* load 1.4: DQN had lower average delay than Congestion-Aware in 7/10 matrices and PDR at least as high in 10/10.
